project: P0/P1 Problem Validation + Hypothesis Validation for MAG physical-relation propagation utility heterogeneity
final_sha_note: The final branch HEAD is reported after commit and push in the completion message; a commit cannot contain its own hash without changing that hash.

probe_hyperparameters.context: uniform incoming one-hop mean on the configured undirected physical graph; no self-loops; no weights; fixed graph degree
probe_hyperparameters.classifier: linear to configured NC class count

utility_definition.sign: positive means removing message raises CE (helpful); negative means removing it lowers CE (harmful)
utility_definition.denominator: original incoming degree, unchanged after deleting one message
utility_definition.counterfactual_arithmetic: float64 linear-head arithmetic after float32 trained projections; verified against brute-force per-message recomputation

split_and_evaluation_policy.analysis_targets: validation nodes and their non-self-loop directed incoming edges only
split_and_evaluation_policy.test_idx: never dereferenced; split accessor raises on request; probe object has no test_idx field
split_and_evaluation_policy.test_labels: not copied into visible probe labels or used in metrics
split_and_evaluation_policy.split_load: torch.load(mmap=True); accessor requests only train_idx and val_idx and raises on test fields

randomness.group_random_sampling: NumPy default_rng seeded per run and modality; same per-target mask count as utility-tail removal
randomness.edge_sample: deterministic up to 8000 rows per dataset×seed; total 72000 rows

exact_commands: python scripts/analyze_p0p1_propagation_heterogeneity.py --output-dir outputs/p0p1_propagation_heterogeneity --research-dir research/p0p1_propagation_heterogeneity --datasets Movies Grocery ele-fashion --seeds 42 43 44

checks: fast vs brute-force logits and utility

notes: Two development campaign attempts stopped at correctness assertions before all runs; after switching the utility oracle to float64 arithmetic, the Movies/42 smoke passed and the final campaign completed all 9 runs.
The first smoke found a missing ${paths.split_root} expansion; corrected before final runs.
Both GPUs were already active at initial inspection; the campaign used cuda:0 and completed without OOM.
